newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPB says insurance unit profit jumps.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPB says insurance unit profit jumps.

text.p: The 1996 pre-tax profit of the insurance unit of Czech banking group IPB a.s., Pojistovna IB, totalled 37.5 million crowns, over three times higher than the company's forecast, according to preliminary results, IPB said on Wednesday.

In a statement, IPB said that IB's new insurance contracts rose 50 percent during the year to over 1.5 billion crowns, and the company's share of the insurance market rose to 3.8 percent from 0.8 percent in 1995.
It said life insurance was the largest area of activity with a total of 1.1 billion crowns in new contracts in 1996, giving IB 10.2 percent of the Czech life insurance market.
Comparative profit results for 1995 were not immediately available.
